title: Exhaustive research: everything adoptable from t3code and external papers/repos/news
body:
Operator (2026-11-06, verbatim): "pamietaj - zbadaj całe jego repo, wszystkie sztuczki, jakosc kodu, zasady, nie wiem cokolwiek, wynajdź wszystko co sexy, to samo względem innych paperów, repo, wzorców z rss news i tak dalej :-)"; grant: "wszystkie triki od theo są dozwolone szefie, to musi być superior tool".
Scope: (a) exhaustive audit of pingdotgg/t3code — every workflow, script, lint/format/type config, AGENTS.md rules, code-quality conventions, test strategy, provider/agent driver patterns, release/dev tooling; (b) same lens over other papers, repos and news/RSS patterns for agent-driven delivery.
Outputs: .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/exhaustive.md and .krn/runs/lead/external-patterns/report.md — enumerate catalogs mechanically, report enumerated vs read (memory: research-enumerate-exhaustively); each finding = what, source path/URL, KRN fit, effort, proof idea.
Then: split adoptable findings into tasks (existing: t-tq04sec t3code agentic tricks, t-nwdj5hx CI speed, t-fgr0es7 research report, t-kgcpy0y/t-mey03ws/t-5qwn3yy research).
